create.name: Radleigh Valentine
create.bio:
Radleigh Valentine is an angel communicator and tarot teacher whose aim is a gentler kind of tarot, with imagery and wording meant to reassure rather than frighten. He has felt drawn to angels since childhood and has worked with tarot for some thirty years, and he gave up a career in finance and accounting to teach full time. His first and best-known deck, Angel Tarot Cards, replaced the darker pictures of traditional decks with angels, fairies and other uplifting figures, and it was followed by around ten further tarot and oracle decks and several books with Hay House, many of them translated into other languages.

Alongside the decks he has written The Big Book of Angel Tarot, a card-by-card guide to symbolism and spreads, and Compendium of Magical Things, a light-hearted survey of divination tools from runes and pendulums to the I Ching and numerology. His central message is that life is magical and that each person has a direct line to the Divine. He runs an online school with self-paced courses on the archangels, tarot reading and manifestation, offers one-to-one angel guidance sessions, records a weekly angel message on YouTube and leads in-person gatherings, including a five-day mastermind in Sedona.

books.title: The Big Book of Angel Tarot: The Essential Guide to Symbols, Spreads, and Accurate Readings
books.author: Radleigh Valentine
books.description: A full companion to his Angel Tarot deck that walks through every card of the Major and Minor Arcana, the court cards and the symbolism in each picture. It also explains common spreads and how to design your own.

books.title: Compendium of Magical Things: Communicating with the Divine to Create the Life of Your Dreams
books.author: Radleigh Valentine
books.description: A friendly introduction to many ways of seeking guidance, from angel and fairy cards to runes, the pendulum, the I Ching, astrology and number lore. Readers are encouraged to find the method that suits them.

books.title: Angel Tarot Cards: A 78-Card Deck and Guidebook
books.author: Radleigh Valentine
books.description: His first tarot deck, illustrated by Steve A. Roberts, which keeps the traditional structure of tarot but uses only gentle, affirming words and images. The guidebook gives each card's meaning and steps for reading for yourself and others.

courses.title: A Journey with the Angels
courses.description: Three of Radleigh's longer guided angel meditations, collected as a self-paced online course to work through in your own time.

courses.title: Archangel Academy
courses.description: A self-paced library of more than thirty video lessons, audio meditations and printable workbooks, covering fifteen archangels and how each is said to communicate.

courses.title: Tarot Made Easy
courses.description: A four-lesson online tarot course for beginners and more experienced readers: getting started, the language of the cards, three-card readings and sharing readings with others.

courses.title: Magical Mystical Mastermind: JOURNEYS, Beyond and Within
courses.description: Five days in person in Sedona, Arizona, exploring sacred places, ancient wisdom, soul memory and the red-rock vortexes with Radleigh and a small group.

courses.title: Breaking Free: Private Angel Guidance Session
courses.description: A 45-minute one-to-one conversation with Radleigh about whatever feels stuck, inviting the angels' perspective and ending with practical next steps.

free_resources.title: Free Guided Meditation: Work with Your Angels to Bring Joy Into Your Life
free_resources.description: A free guided meditation in which Radleigh leads you to meet your angels and invite their support into everyday life. Access is by email sign-up.
